text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Kiraaan☆
text_block_list.orig_text: きらーんっ☆

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Uwaaah! As expected of Hatsune-taso! Defeating a brawny monster like that in a single blow like it's nobody's business. However, it's my business to know if there's maybe a secret to your magic...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おー
さすがハツネたそ。
屈強な魔物を一撃で倒すとは。
ひょっとして
今の魔法にも何か秘密が……？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: That just now was simple magic, really. On another note, I'm sorry for earlier, Nanaka-chan, it seems I've caused you some trouble by falling asleep.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今のは普通の魔法だよ～
でもごめんね、
ナナカちゃん。
私が眠ったせいで迷惑掛けちゃって。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: No big deal, really. If anything, I'm grateful to you for showing me your cute sleeping face. Very grateful!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんのなんの。
むしろ
かわいらしい寝顔を見せていただき、
感謝感謝ですぞ。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: More importantly, Hatsune-taso, are you doing fine?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それより、
ハツネたそは大丈夫なの？

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Hm? With what?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
なにが？

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: I was wondering if it'll be okay for you to climb this tower after using that magic that came with a price earlier.
text_block_list.orig_text:
代償を伴うほどの強力な魔法を使ったあとなのに
塔を登っても平気なのかな～
って。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: A-Ah... if that's what you're worried about, don't. It seems I was hindered by the magic that's enhancing the Tower's protection, so I didn't use as much ES-... I mean, magical power as usual.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あ～～
それなら大丈夫だよ。
塔に掛かってる魔法？　
に邪魔されたみたいで
いつもより超……
力をそんなに使わなかったから。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: To think it'd even interfere with the special magic that Hatsune-taso uses... I knew it, this tower truly isn't normal.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハツネたそが使った特殊な魔法すら阻害する……
やっぱり
この塔は普通じゃないんだね。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Thinking about it now, even if we were able to fly to the top in one go, if I were to fell asleep after, I would've put {0}-kun in great danger. I'm glad I failed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よく考えたら
一気に飛べても私が眠っちゃったら
{0}くんに迷惑掛けちゃうよね。
失敗してよかったよ。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Putting that aside, could you tell me more about that magic? It looked like a teleportation spell at a glance, but something was different.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても
あの魔法はなんだったの？
パッと見
転移魔法みたいだったけど、
な～んか違ったし。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: U-Umm... That's...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
え～～
っと
アレは……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Ah, if it's difficult for you to disclose, you don't have to! Sure, it’d be great if you could teach me, but... I understand it might not be easy to share the great magic spell you worked so hard to create!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
言いづらいことなら
言わなくてもいいよ！
確かに
教えてもらえたら
助かるけど、
苦労して編み出した魔法を
そう簡単に教えられないよね！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: That's not really what this is about...
text_block_list.orig_text: そういうことじゃないんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: But this Nanaka-chan has a recurring saga of adventures that led her to become unable to resist to the allure of learning new magic. And that's because I'm... a magical girl!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
このナナカちゃんは
新しい魔法を見たら
探求せずにはいられないサガの持ち主。
なぜなら私は……
魔法少女だから！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Now, now, don't sweat the small stuff. Curiosity is one trait everyone deserves to treasure!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁまぁ
細かいことは気にしない。
探求心は大切にしなきゃいけないからね！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: If you won't tell me, then I'll just watch and learn it for myself. I won't miss a single move of Hatsune-taso from now on!
text_block_list.orig_text:
教えてもらえないなら
見て盗むまで。
ハツネたその
一挙手一投足見逃しませんぞ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: *Staaaaare*...

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Staring at me so attentively is quite embarassing~
text_block_list.orig_text: そんなに見つめられると恥ずかしいよ～

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Oh~~ It's always nice to see a beautiful girl blush... Wait, I'm getting sidetracked here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お～～
美少女が頬を染めるのは
いつ見てもいいものですな～
……って、
これじゃ目的が変わっちゃうよ！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: My goal is to be a healthy magical girl who takes magic seriously!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は
魔法に真摯に向き合う
健全な魔法少女でいたい！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, Nanaka-chan you're quite amusing. My magic is the kind that you can't learn even if I were to teach you, but I'd be happy if you learned something by watching me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
ナナカちゃんっておもしろいね。
私のあれは教えたくても教えられるものじゃないけど、
何か役に立てたらうれしいな。

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Well, even if this goal of mine doesn't see fruition here, I hope we can still find a clue to {0}'s memories.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ、
私の目的がうまくいかなくても、
{0}君の記憶の手がかりが見つかれば
それでいいしね。

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: ...Let's do our best together to achieve that!
text_block_list.orig_text: 一緒にがんばろうね！

text_block_list.name: Nanaka
text_block_list.text: Putting that aside... Staring at Hatsune-taso is a treat for the eyes, so I'll keep staring for NOW!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは
それとして……
ハツネたそを見つめるのは
目の保養になるから
見つめ続けるのですけどね！

text_block_list.name: Hatsune
text_block_list.text: EEEEHHHHH?!

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, Hatsune and {0} climbed the tower while Nanaka continued to stare at her.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その後、ハツネはナナカに見つめ続けられながら、
塔を登っていくのであった。
